result.instructions: Tools for Tokko Broker, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the properties we have published and their current prices."; "Show me the developments and how many units each one has."; "Find the CRM contacts that asked about a property this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tokko Broker data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tokkobroker_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tokkobroker_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tokkobroker_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tokkobroker_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tokkobroker_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the agency's properties (listings) with id, title, address, operation type and prices. Returns meta (total_count, limit, offset, next) and objects. Tokko API: GET /api/v1/property/.

tools.name: tokkobroker_get_property
tools.title: Get property
tools.description: Get one property by id with its full details (location, features, operations, photos). Tokko API: GET /api/v1/property/{id}/.

tools.name: tokkobroker_list_developments
tools.title: List developments
tools.description: List the agency's developments (real-estate projects with several units). Tokko API: GET /api/v1/development/.

tools.name: tokkobroker_get_development
tools.title: Get development
tools.description: Get one development by id with its details and units. Tokko API: GET /api/v1/development/{id}/.

tools.name: tokkobroker_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts (leads and clients) of the agency. Personal data: use only for the agency's own follow-up. Tokko API: GET /api/v1/contact/.

tools.name: tokkobroker_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one CRM contact by id. Personal data: use only for the agency's own follow-up. Tokko API: GET /api/v1/contact/{id}/.
